findings.summary: The player died six times between 3.0 s and 34.0 s and said they could not see what was killing them, so they had nothing visible to learn from or avoid and became increasingly frustrated.

quotes.text: Wait, why did I die again? I can't can't see what's killing me
That's the fourth time time now. This is really frustrating.

evidence.visual: During the window the screen stays black apart from the white timer text in the top-left corner, with a brief full-screen white flash around 2 s. No enemy, hazard, or other visible cause of the deaths is shown.

findings.suggested_fix: Make the lethal hazard clearly visible before it kills: draw it as a bright red shape and make it flash for 1 second before it becomes lethal.
